title: Grilled Chicken Salad
description: A fresh and protein-packed salad with grilled chicken breast, mixed greens, and a light vinaigrette.
steps: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Grill chicken over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Let chicken rest for 5 minutes, then slice.
Combine salad greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion in a large bowl.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, and Dijon mustard for the dressing.
Arrange salad on plates, top with sliced chicken, and drizzle with dressing.

title: Overnight Oats with Berries
description: Creamy overnight oats topped with fresh berries and a drizzle of honey. Perfect make-ahead breakfast.
steps: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, and cinnamon in a jar.
Stir well, seal the jar, and refrigerate overnight (at least 6 hours).
In the morning, top with fresh berries and a drizzle of honey.
Enjoy cold or microwave for 1-2 minutes if you prefer warm oats.

title: Hearty Lentil Soup
description: A warming, fiber-rich lentil soup with carrots, celery, and aromatic spices.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Sauté onion, carrots, and celery for 5 minutes.
Add garlic, cumin, and paprika; cook for 1 minute.
Add lentils, broth, and diced tomatoes.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 25 minutes until lentils are tender.
Season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice before serving.

title: Salmon & Quinoa Power Bowl
description: A nutrient-dense bowl with baked salmon, fluffy quinoa, roasted vegetables, and a tahini drizzle.
ingredients: Salt, pepper, and paprika to taste
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Toss sweet potato and broccoli with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast for 20 minutes.
Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
Season salmon with paprika, salt, and pepper. Bake for 12-15 minutes.
Whisk together tahini, lemon juice, maple syrup, and 2 tbsp water for the drizzle.
Assemble bowls: quinoa base, roasted veggies, salmon on top, drizzle with tahini sauce.

title: 3-Ingredient Banana Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes made with just banana, eggs, and oats. A simple, healthy breakfast treat.
ingredients: Coconut oil or spray for cooking
steps: Mash bananas in a bowl.
Add eggs and oats (and cinnamon if using), then mix well.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat with a little coconut oil.
Pour small rounds of batter (about 2 tbsp each).
Cook for 2-3 minutes until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1-2 more minutes.
Serve with fresh fruit or a drizzle of honey.

title: Coconut Chickpea Curry
description: A rich and creamy curry with chickpeas, coconut milk, and aromatic spices. Vegan comfort food at its best.
steps: Heat coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Sauté onion for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add garlic and ginger; cook for 1 minute.
Add curry powder and turmeric; stir for 30 seconds.
Pour in diced tomatoes and coconut milk; stir to combine.
Add chickpeas and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve over rice, garnished with fresh cilantro.

title: Greek Yogurt Protein Bowl
description: A creamy, high-protein breakfast bowl loaded with toppings for crunch and flavor.
steps: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with granola, banana slices, and blueberries.
Sprinkle with chia seeds.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.

title: Turkey-Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Colorful bell peppers stuffed with lean ground turkey, rice, and veggies — a balanced meal in a pepper.
steps: Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F).
Cut the tops off peppers and remove seeds. Place in a baking dish.
Heat olive oil in a skillet. Cook onion and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add ground turkey, cook until browned. Season with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning.
Stir in cooked rice and half the diced tomatoes.
Fill each pepper with the turkey mixture.
Pour remaining tomatoes around the peppers in the dish.
Top peppers with mozzarella, cover with foil, and bake for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake 5 more minutes until cheese is golden.

title: Avocado Toast with Poached Eggs
description: Classic avocado toast elevated with perfectly poached eggs. A satisfying and nutritious breakfast.
steps: Toast the bread slices until golden.
Mash avocado with a fork and season with salt and pepper.
Bring a pot of water to a gentle simmer, add vinegar.
Create a swirl and gently drop each egg into the water. Poach for 3-4 minutes.
Spread mashed avocado on each toast.
Place a poached egg on each toast. Season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Garnish with microgreens and serve immediately.

title: Quick Black Bean Tacos
description: Simple, flavorful tacos loaded with spiced black beans, fresh salsa, and creamy avocado.
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add black beans, cumin, chili powder, and garlic powder.
Cook for 5 minutes, mashing slightly with a fork.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or directly over a gas flame.
Fill each tortilla with spiced black beans.
Top with avocado slices, salsa, and fresh cilantro.
Serve with lime wedges.
